Description
For industrial applications, the information about thermal physical properties of the materials and heat transfer of final products is becoming more important these days. The flash method has developed as the most commonly used methods for measuring the thermal diffusion and thermal conductivity of different kinds of powders, liquids and solids for years. 
The Linseis LFA 1000 Laser Flash is an ideal device for determining Thermal Diffusivity, Conductivity and Specific Heat Values. It is a precise and most popular instrument and allows unbeaten turnaround times for up to 6 Samples at the same time. For measurements from -125 up to 2800°C, it is equipped with three user exchangeable furnaces. 
It is used for applications such as solids, liquids, melts and slabs, where many sample holders are available. It can be installed under a hood for nuclear applications due to its compact size. Moreover, the design makes it easy to separate the electronics and hardware.
